Continuously captures and summarizes ambient conversations to build a local knowledge graph for context-aware assistance without explicit commands.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of percept-ambient: enables ambient intelligence mode with continuous, passive context awareness.
- Builds a knowledge graph of conversations, entities, and relationships over time.
- Integrates with percept-listen and percept-summarize for capturing and extracting context.
- Provides full-text and semantic search (FTS5 and LanceDB) and assembles "Context Packets" on demand.
- All data stored locally, with configurable privacy controls and no audio retention.
- Includes a real-time dashboard for live monitoring, search, and analytics.
